exposure: previous successful vaginal birth after cesarean surgery
outcome: successful vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: Women with a prior cesarean section attempting a vaginal delivery at Felege Hiwot Comprehensive and Specialized Referral Hospital between February 30, 2017, and March 30, 2021.
finding: A prediction model including parity, membrane rupture, onset of labor, prior history of VBAC, inter-delivery gap, and ANC beginning time was developed with an AUC of 0.748 (95% CI: 0.714-0.781).
